headings: (1 L) MUSK SHADES BODY LIQUID SOAP

jsonld_raw.name: (1 L) MUSK SHADES BODY LIQUID SOAP
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented liquid body soap. Presented in a container with a pump dispenser.

Aroma: Musk Shades | The transparency of musk reflects a fragrance full of innocence and sweetness. An explosion of citrus notes and tea leaves opens up to an impeccable floral aura of sun-drenched jasmine petals and mimosa. The base leaves a lingering musk that offers an unparalleled sensation of purity.

Notes:
Top notes: kumquat, mint.
Heart notes: mimosa, transparent flower.
Base notes: tea, musk.
